gpu_basis: container started without --gpus and exposes no /dev/nvidia* device, so this arm cannot allocate GPU memory at query time -- structurally 0, not merely observed 0
prep_a100_hours: 0.0 -- indexing for this arm is API-mediated; it has no GPU stage
context_only_note: api.local_search always generates; the generation leg's duration is measured from litellm start/end stamps and subtracted, so context_only_* is what compares against the other arms. Validity is bounded by gen_capture_rate: a query whose success callback lands outside its window subtracts nothing and reports context_only == total, which inflates the UPPER tail only. Read the median, treat context_only_p95 as an upper bound.
